sql.if: where trunc(sysdate) between trunc(startDate) and trunc(endDate)

mapper.insert: insert into notice(no, title, content, startDate, endDate) values(notice_seq.nextval, #{title}, #{content}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})
mapper.update: update notice set title = #{title}, content = #{content}, startDate = #{startDate}, endDate = #{endDate}, updateDate = sysdate where no = #{no}
